title: Extend impl-defined Space governance pattern to remaining sites
description:
Follow-up to commit c93e545 ("refactor: implementation-defined Space governance"), which removed the normative single-owner concept from Space governance in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.

Two related sites in the corpus still encode the old single-distinguished-principal pattern and are now inconsistent with the main draft:

1. The filenode draft's permissions table still names a "Space owner" row.
2. The main draft's group-chat creation flow still mandates that the creator becomes admin and refers to initial non-creator members as "non-owner members".

Both are direct analogs of the Space pattern that was just generalized. The wire contract is satisfied by the role/permission enum and what each role may do; *who starts privileged* is deployment policy.

See §Space Governance: Deployment Variation (anchor: {#space-deployment}) in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md for the canonical wording pattern.

Scope: this epic is the corpus-consistency follow-up. Estimated size: one commit, similar in shape to c93e545.
